# Test housing for exchange students

## Residences reserved for exchange students
- Residence Alpha: single room with private bathroom, 5-minute walk from campus.
- Residence Beta: single room in a shared apartment.

## Prices for the whole semester
- Residence Alpha: EUR 4,000 for the semester, bills included.
- Residence Beta: EUR 3,200 for the semester, bills included.

## How to apply
- Apply online after your exchange nomination at https://example.org/housing/apply
- Rooms are assigned first come, first served.
